mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, reviewer_id, reviewee_id, star_rating, comment) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reviewerId}, #{revieweeId}, #{starRating}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}
SELECT review.*, reviewer.username AS reviewer_username FROM review JOIN user reviewer ON reviewer.id = review.reviewer_id WHERE reviewee_id = #{revieweeId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT review.*, reviewee.username AS reviewer_username FROM review JOIN user reviewee ON reviewee.id = review.reviewee_id WHERE reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
